name: data-grid
title: Data Grid
description: The full-parity grid — client or host-sorted multi-key sort, frozen, resizable and windowed columns, header reorder, client or host grouping flattened into the row virtualiser, a summary row, cursor paging, and an APG grid keyboard layer with inline cell editing.

meta.whenToUse: Record tables that need grouping, inline cell editing, multi-key sort, column management, frozen or resizable columns, or 10k+ rows and 100+ columns via row and column virtualization — the CRM pipeline-table and spreadsheet tier.
meta.whenNotToUse: Simple presentational record lists — DataList is lighter and still the right default; kanban views (Board).
